direction: The unchanged collective OF operator acts on each reoptimized carrier, not the old K2 state. No operator or epsilon scan.
controls: At rank r+1 compare B+OF psi_B with B+H psi_B and global rank-matched Krylov. At rank r+2 compare span(B,H psi_B)+orthogonal innovation with the second H step and global rank-matched Krylov. Also retain F-only and old-input controls.
scramble_scope: Nonlocal orthogonal rotations fixing the complete B+H psi_B space; diagnostic, not lattice-local scrambles.
stopping_rule: Report all 18 registered cells, including rank failures; no coupling/partition/seed selection. No full-sector Hamiltonian diagonalization: reuse sealed exact states. Only Ritz problems of dimension <=7 are solved. Rank matching is not GPU-work matching. A geometrically independent vector or a nested-space lowering alone is not a win.
